findings.evidence: <button id="project-settings-duplicate-btn" type="button" aria-label="Duplicate project"></button> with no href, no linked result state, and no specified outcome or confirmation
findings.violation: The duplicate project action has no specified feedback showing what the user sees when it completes or whether it succeeded
findings.fix: Specify what happens when the user clicks duplicate - for example, a new project entry in the workspace overview, a naming screen for the duplicate, or a confirmation showing the duplicated project

findings.evidence: After archiving (reaching #project-archived confirmation), only a "Back to your projects" link is provided. No unarchive, restore, or way to access archived projects is specified anywhere in the artifact
findings.violation: The archive action, which is reasonably reversible in a project management system, offers no stated way to undo or restore the archived project in the design as specified
findings.fix: Provide an unarchive or restore option, either on the project-archived confirmation screen or linked from a separate archived projects management screen that is reachable from the artifact

findings.location: The "project-settings" section, Save button in the project name form
findings.evidence: <button id="project-settings-save-btn" type="submit">Save</button> in a form with no specified result screen or confirmation
findings.violation: The Save action for the project name has no specified feedback showing what the user sees when it completes or confirming success
findings.fix: Specify a result state - such as a success message appearing on or near the button, a full confirmation screen, or a changed control state - so the user knows the save completed

instances.location: The "notification-settings" section, Save button in the digest frequency form
instances.evidence: <button id="notification-settings-save-btn" type="submit">Save</button> in a form with no specified result screen or confirmation

instances.location: The "invite-member" section, Save button in the email form
instances.evidence: <button id="invite-member-save-btn" type="submit">Save</button> in a form where the next step is unclear - a separate "Continue" link appears below, but it is not specified whether the Save navigates to invite-sent or if the user must click Continue

findings.evidence: Error message: "Import failed. Error code IMP-500. Contact support if this continues." The only control on the screen is "Back to your projects" link; no support contact form or link is provided
findings.violation: The error message suggests 'Contact support' as a recovery action, but provides no way to contact support or link to support from the error screen where the message appears
findings.fix: Either provide a 'Contact support' link or button on the screen that is reachable from this error, or replace the suggested recovery with an action that is available (such as 'Retry import' or 'Back to your projects')

findings.evidence: "Import failed. Error code IMP-500. Contact support if this continues."
findings.violation: The error message reports that the import failed and presents an internal error code, but does not explain specifically what went wrong in terms the user understands (network error, unsupported file format, file too large, permission denied, etc.)
findings.fix: Replace or supplement the error code with a plain-language explanation of the specific failure cause, so the user knows whether to retry, fix their input, contact support, or take another action

findings.evidence: Confirmation text reads: "An invite was sent to the address entered above. It expires in 5 days if not accepted." The email address is not displayed on the screen; it is only referenced as "the address entered above"
findings.violation: The confirmation screen needs the email address the user provided, but refers to it only by reference to a previous screen without displaying it, requiring the user to navigate back to verify what address was used
findings.fix: Display the email address on the invite-sent confirmation screen (e.g., 'An invite was sent to user@example.com. It expires in 5 days if not accepted.') so the user can verify it without going back
